LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Gecko.label: Gecko
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Gecko.description: The urban-combat conversion of the bipedal Iguana. Its base armor has been deliberately thinned to free up weight for a set of add-on electromagnetic reactive armor bricks that outright negate single high-damage hits from shaped charges and explosives; against small arms fire, however, its skin is thinner than the Iguana's.

LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Iguana.label: Iguana
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Iguana.description: A heavy bipedal IFV redesigned on the basis of the Tarbosaurus, with the excellent qualities of small size, low cost and suitability for mass production. This model carries no electromagnetic reactive armor, giving up dedicated protection against shaped charges in exchange for the thickest base armor and best sustained mobility in its class.
